'''CT-3636''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] in the months following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. CT-3636 was part of an enforcer squad led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] who were attempting to find the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Cho'na Bene]] in the [[Howling Ruins]] on [[Vaklin]]. CT-3636 was contacted by fellow clone trooper [[CT-3632]], who informed him that no activity had been detected, which CT-3636 responded to by requesting a seventy-meter perimeter sweep. Shortly after, he was shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the squad were [[Ambush in the Howling Ruins|ambushed]] by insurgents.<ref name="TF1" />
